description: German morphology variants of golden-set v1 questions: each re-asks a base question with a different inflection, a split compound ("Antragseingangsmaske" → "Maske für den Antragseingang") or a derivation ("Vorgangsverwaltung" → "Vorgänge verwaltet"). Expected answers are the base question's. The v1 questions appear verbatim in the corpus, so they cannot show whether stemming or compound splitting work; this set can (compare FTS_LANGUAGE=simple, german and a compound configuration). Version 1.1.0 adds 7 variants of unanswerable (abstain) base questions: the system must still find nothing relevant when the unanswerable question is phrased with other word forms.
